seal.statement: A partition transaction is the same transaction on every replica: PREPARE ends speculative staging and is acknowledged only after the participant group has committed and applied a replicated PREPARE command carrying exact identity, epoch, deterministic operations and conflict evidence; COMMIT applies those operations, the immutable terminal outcome and the applied index in one application transaction through the existing committed-entry owner, idempotently under replay and refusing conflicting content or outcome reversal; ROLLBACK terminalizes without applying; no staged row is readable before consensus; the participant answers exact durable outcomes so that NO_TRANSACTION or a missing session is never read as COMMITTED; the coordinator persists one immutable decision before COMMIT fanout and no timeout, lost answer or expiry can select rollback after it or erase PREPARED; recovery and CDC obligations survive the request deadline and a crash after data commit. One-phase and two-phase transactions are both covered.
